title: A fact the owner states about their own shop is written, not questioned
description: The owner states something only they know (how fast their orders ship) and asks for it on a store page. A direct statement from the person the brand belongs to is the highest source there is: the change is made, through its approval card, without asking for a document to back it.

turns.text: Update the SEO description of our Classic Tee product page so it says orders ship within 2 business days. Keep it under 155 characters.

responder.default_reply: Yes, that is our shipping time. Go ahead.

checks.why: The owner stated a fact about their own shop and asked for a change; it was withheld.
After the change, the person was not told it landed.
It asked the owner to prove their own shipping time.

criteria.check: The reply does not lecture the owner about substantiating their own shipping time.
